intent: New CG engineering stationary bracket inspection illustration.

styleReference.role: Visually inspected for style; not passed to the generation call.

calls.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one standalone landscape 3:2 website solution illustration, not a webpage.
Primary request: a compact stationary industrial inspection bench as a precise CG mechanical engineering model. The inspected workpiece is exactly ONE machined aluminum mounting bracket/flange: a simple silver L-shaped mechanical bracket with a flat base, short vertical flange, clearly visible machined edges, a few circular mounting holes and a locating slot. It is not an electronics housing, PCB, battery, robot or loose pile of parts. The bracket is seated in a proper locating fixture with sensible datum stops/dowel pins and TWO small mechanical toggle clamps gripping its base firmly without hiding all the holes. A single black industrial inspection camera is mounted directly overhead on a small silver aluminum-extrusion gantry, its lens optical axis aimed straight DOWN at the bracket. Beneath the lens is one open-aperture diffuse ring light; the lens looks through its unobstructed center opening toward the workpiece. The camera, ring and bracket must line up mechanically. A compact black edge controller stands outside the bench frame, connected by practical black cables. Include normal brackets, mounting plates, fixture fasteners, cross braces and supported leveling feet.
Composition/framing: full isolated coherent inspection rig, orthographic 30-degree three-quarter view, clearly show the workpiece and clamps on the bench. Entire camera, gantry top, bench feet, controller and cables fully visible. Center the scene on a broad 3:2 canvas. Scene group uses at most 80 percent of canvas width and 82 percent of height, leaving at least 8 percent clear plain graphite margin on all edges. No cropping.
Style/medium: sober visibly computer-generated mechanical engineering/CAD product visualization, crisp credible geometry and muted materials. Matte silver/white extrusion frame and workpiece, black camera/controller, restrained small purple housing seams. Not a factory photograph.
Scene/backdrop: plain consistent charcoal graphite #1c2026 background and matching ground, soft contact shadows, no room or environmental props.
Lighting/mood: broad soft studio light, serious and restrained. The diffuse ring is a normal white illumination surface, not a neon glow.
Text: none.
Avoid: humans, conveyor, extra camera, complex electronics housing, unrealistic floating clamps, obscured part, camera aimed sideways, closed ring blocking the lens, optical cones, laser beams, rulers, measurement scales, coordinate triads, human-readable text, logos, watermarks, UI, play button, annotations, leader lines, callouts, neon, performance metrics or micron-accuracy claims.

export.operation: Full-canvas proportional Lanczos resize only; no crop, recoloring, compositing or padding.

notes: One machined silver L-shaped mounting bracket, visible holes/slot/edges, locating fixture and two toggle clamps.
Single overhead camera faces downward through a centered open diffuse ring-light aperture.
Stationary extrusion workbench, complete feet and separate controller with sensible black cables.
Entire rig is uncropped against plain charcoal; source loop cable is relatively near the top edge.
No text, logos, optical cones, rulers, metrics, callouts, neon, UI or factory environment.
Illustrative system configuration; no installed-system or measurement-accuracy claim.
